name: Apotheosis
source:
The story follows a secret service agent Callisto di Moretti, who was sent to the capital in order to uncover a plot, planned by enemies of the current order. Callisto will have to oppose mighty enemies, as well as his own internal conflicts that have been tearing him apart for a few years prior to the events of the novel.

[From [url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/10rlpdr/we_are_developing_apotheosis_a_new_vn/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一名特工卡利斯托·迪·莫雷蒂被派往首都，以揭露当前秩序的敌人策划的阴谋。卡利斯托将不得不对抗强大的敌人，以及他自己的内部冲突，这些冲突在小说中的事件发生前几年就已经让他四分五裂。

[来自[url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/10rlpdr/we_are_developing_apotheosis_a_new_vn/]Reddit[/url]]
